methodologyNotes: Re-verified via WebFetch on official pricing/security pages (15five.com, lattice.com, weekdone.com, mooncamp.com, peoplebox.ai, leapsome.com, profit.co, workboard.com) and WebSearch corroboration (G2, Capterra). 15Five, Lattice, Peoplebox, Mooncamp prices confirmed EXACT on official pages. Weekdone and Quantive per-user prices corroborated via Capterra/G2/WebSearch (official Weekdone page uses an interactive calculator; quantive.com/pricing 302-redirects to workboard.com following the May 2025 WorkBoard acquisition). Profit.co and WorkBoard are custom/contact-sales only (monthlyUsd=null). Leapsome publishes only a $199/month floor, not a per-seat rate (monthlyUsd=null). Mooncamp publishes EUR only (monthlyUsd=null). Microsoft Viva Goals (retired Dec 31 2025) excluded. KEY CORRECTION: Profit.co 'BAA available' was fabricated - profit.co/security states HIPAA/SOC2/ISO27001/GDPR but NO BAA, so baa set to null. Compliance flags set true only where the vendor explicitly states it. accessedAt 2026-06-15.
